notes.source_line: The Behavioral Economics and Psychology (BEEP) program aims to train students in a comprehensive set of skills necessary to understand how economic actors make decisions in real-life settings, to understand how these decisions affect economic and social outcomes and to design interventions to improve these outcomes. Concretely, students will:

notes.text: 1. acquire knowledge about human cognition and decision-making and become capable of modeling behavior;
notes.source_line: 1. acquire knowledge about human cognition and decision-making and become capable of modeling behavior;

notes.text: 2. study how individual behavior affects outcomes in strategic interactions and markets; and
notes.source_line: 2. study how individual behavior affects outcomes in strategic interactions and markets; and

notes.text: 3. learn tools to collect and analyze information relevant to the areas of inquiry explored in the program.
